itens.descricao: Builds an ordered middleware stack around a final handler, returning a Middlewares slice that can wrap any http.Handler or http.HandlerFunc.
itens.motivo: Chain() returns a Middlewares slice. Its Handler and HandlerFunc methods wrap a final http.Handler or http.HandlerFunc, and chain() applies the middlewares in order.

itens.descricao: Declares the chi package entry point, the NewRouter constructor, the Router and Routes interfaces, and the Middlewares type.
itens.motivo: The file has the package doc, NewRouter (which calls NewMux), the Router and Routes interfaces, and the Middlewares type.

itens.descricao: Stores route patterns, URL parameters, and routing path overrides in a request context, with helpers to read URL params and clone the context.
itens.motivo: Context holds RoutePatterns, URLParams and RoutePath/RouteMethod. The file provides URLParam, URLParamFromCtx and Clone, which deep-copies the slices.

itens.descricao: Checks HTTP Basic credentials against a static user map using constant-time password comparison and answers failures with 401 and a WWW-Authenticate challenge.
itens.motivo: The middleware looks the user up in the creds map and compares the password with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. On failure it sets WWW-Authenticate and writes 401.

itens.descricao: Collapses repeated slashes in the request path by applying path.Clean to the routing path before the next handler runs.
itens.motivo: When RoutePath is empty, it takes RawPath or Path and sets rctx.RoutePath = path.Clean(...) before calling next. path.Clean collapses the repeated slashes.

itens.descricao: Stores the client IP from trusted proxy headers, X-Forwarded-For hops, or RemoteAddr in the request context, and reads it back with GetClientIP.
itens.motivo: ClientIPFromHeader, ClientIPFromXFF, ClientIPFromXFFTrustedProxies and ClientIPFromRemoteAddr store a netip.Addr in the context under clientIPCtxKey. GetClientIP reads it back.

itens.descricao: Compresses response bodies for configured content types based on Accept-Encoding, with pluggable encoders registered through SetEncoder.
itens.motivo: Compress picks an encoder from Accept-Encoding and compresses only responses whose Content-Type is allowed. Encoders are registered through Compressor.SetEncoder.

itens.descricao: Responds 415 when a body's Content-Type charset is not in the allowed list, always allowing requests without a body and accepting missing charsets only if "" is listed.
itens.motivo: It returns 415 when the charset is not in the list. ContentLength == 0 is always allowed. A missing charset yields "", which matches only if "" is in the list.

itens.descricao: Responds 415 when any Content-Encoding value on a request body is outside a configured allowlist, skipping requests with zero content length.
itens.motivo: It skips the check when ContentLength is 0. Otherwise every Content-Encoding header value must be in the allowed set, or it writes 415.

itens.descricao: Sets a fixed response header and enforces an allowlist of request Content-Type values, answering 415 for unlisted types on non-empty bodies.
itens.motivo: SetHeader sets a fixed response header. AllowContentType checks the request media type against an allowlist, skips empty bodies, and answers 415 otherwise.

itens.descricao: Adds a Deprecation header per RFC 9745 with a Structured Field Date and optional Link headers, and panics when the given deprecation time is zero.
itens.motivo: It sets the Deprecation header to "@<unix>", which is the Structured Field Date format. It adds each link as a Link header and panics if deprecatedAt.IsZero().

itens.descricao: Routes an unmatched HEAD request to the GET handler by running a look-ahead match on a temporary route context before continuing with the HEAD method.
itens.motivo: For HEAD it makes a temporary context and calls Routes.Match for HEAD. If there is no match it sets RouteMethod to GET and continues with the request still a HEAD.

itens.descricao: Answers GET and HEAD requests matching a configured path with a 200 text/plain response and skips the next handler, a probe for load balancers.
itens.motivo: Para GET/HEAD com path igual ao endpoint (sem diferenciar maiúsculas), responde 200 text/plain com '.' e retorna sem chamar o próximo handler.

itens.descricao: Logs each request once when it completes, with status, size, and duration through a pluggable LogFormatter, using color only when stdout is a TTY.
itens.motivo: A cor não depende de o stdout ser um TTY. O init() só desativa a cor quando runtime.GOOS == "windows"; não há verificação de TTY. O resto (log único ao concluir, via LogFormatter) está certo.

itens.descricao: Applies a wrapped middleware only when a request predicate returns true, otherwise passing the request straight to the next handler.
itens.motivo: Se maybeFn(r) é verdadeiro, usa o handler envolvido por mw; caso contrário chama next diretamente.

itens.descricao: Wraps a plain http.Handler as middleware, ignoring the next handler, and defines the unexported contextKey type for context values.
itens.motivo: New converte um http.Handler em middleware que chama h.ServeHTTP e ignora next. O tipo contextKey não exportado está definido no mesmo arquivo.

itens.descricao: Sets headers that stop upstream proxies and clients from caching the response, and deletes ETag and conditional headers from the request.
itens.motivo: Define Expires, Cache-Control, Pragma e X-Accel-Expires na resposta e remove da requisição ETag, If-Modified-Since, If-Match, If-None-Match e outros cabeçalhos condicionais.

itens.descricao: Serves a fixed handler for GET requests whose path matches a given value case-insensitively, passing all other requests to the next handler.
itens.motivo: Só atende com o handler fixo quando o método é GET e o path coincide sem diferenciar maiúsculas (EqualFold). Todo o resto vai para next.

itens.descricao: Replaces the first occurrence of a substring in the request URL path with a new value before passing the request to the next handler.
itens.motivo: strings.Replace com n=1 troca apenas a primeira ocorrência em r.URL.Path e depois chama next.

itens.descricao: Builds a chi subrouter that wraps every debug route in a no-cache middleware and redirects the root and /pprof paths to the /pprof/ index, for mounting under /debug.
itens.motivo: Cria um subrouter chi com r.Use(NoCache), que cobre todas as rotas. A rota raiz redireciona para /pprof/ e /pprof redireciona para a versão com barra final. O subrouter é pensado para ser montado em /debug.

itens.descricao: Rewrites r.RemoteAddr from True-Client-IP, X-Real-IP, or X-Forwarded-For headers, and is deprecated because it trusts those headers whether or not the infrastructure sets them.
itens.motivo: Reescreve r.RemoteAddr com True-Client-IP, X-Real-IP ou X-Forwarded-For, nessa ordem. O comentário Deprecated diz que isso é vulnerável porque os cabeçalhos são aceitos quer a infraestrutura os defina ou não.

itens.descricao: Recovers from panics in downstream handlers and logs a pretty stack trace, returning 500 only when Connection is not Upgrade, but re-panics http.ErrAbortHandler.
itens.motivo: Recupera o panic e registra a pilha formatada. Escreve 500 apenas se Connection != "Upgrade" e relança http.ErrAbortHandler.

itens.descricao: Reuses the X-Request-Id request header when present, otherwise generates a unique ID from a host prefix and an atomic counter, readable through GetReqID.
itens.motivo: Usa o cabeçalho X-Request-Id se existir. Senão gera prefixo (hostname/aleatório) mais um contador atômico, e GetReqID lê o valor do contexto.

itens.descricao: Caps every request body at a configured byte count by wrapping r.Body with http.MaxBytesReader before calling the next handler.
itens.motivo: Envolve r.Body com http.MaxBytesReader usando o limite configurado antes de chamar o próximo handler.

itens.descricao: Routes a request through different middleware stacks based on matching header values, with pattern matching and a default route for unmatched requests.
itens.motivo: HeaderRouter maps lowercase header names to routes with wildcard Pattern matching (prefix/suffix via strings.Cut), and a "*" default route is used when nothing matches.

itens.descricao: Provides StripSlashes to drop trailing slashes before routing, RedirectSlashes to redirect them, and StripPrefix to remove a path prefix from the request.
itens.motivo: StripSlashes removes one trailing slash from the route path, RedirectSlashes issues a 301 to the path without it, and StripPrefix delegates to http.StripPrefix.

itens.descricao: Adds a Sunset header per RFC 8594 announcing when a route stops working, and panics when the sunset date is the zero time.
itens.motivo: Sets the Sunset header in HTTP time format, cites RFC 8594, and panics at construction if sunsetAt.IsZero().
itens.trecho: panic("middleware.Sunset: sunsetAt must not be zero")

itens.descricao: Checks the route table before the rest of the stack and answers unmatched requests with the router's not-found handler, skipping later middleware.
itens.motivo: Uses rctx.Routes.Match on a fresh route context, and if there is no match calls router.NotFoundHandler() without calling next.

itens.descricao: Detects whether stdout is a TTY with a character-device heuristic and writes colored text through cW, used by the logger and recoverer.
itens.motivo: init sets IsTTY by checking that stdout's mode has the device and char-device bits; cW wraps Fprintf with color codes only if IsTTY and useColor; cW is called in logger.go and recoverer.go.

itens.descricao: Caps in-flight requests across all users, with optional backlog and timeout, and sets Retry-After on rejected requests when RetryAfterFn is configured.
itens.motivo: Token channels cap in-flight requests globally (not per user), BacklogLimit and BacklogTimeout configure the queue, and Retry-After is set only when retryAfterFn is non-nil.

itens.descricao: Cancels the request context after a timeout and returns 504 Gateway Timeout, relying on the handler to observe ctx.Done for the signal to take effect.
itens.motivo: Wraps the context with WithTimeout and, in a defer, writes 504 if ctx.Err() is DeadlineExceeded; the handler must watch ctx.Done to stop early.

itens.descricao: Parses a trailing file extension from the request path into the context under URLFormatCtxKey and trims it from the routing path before continuing.
itens.motivo: Extracts the extension after the last dot in the last path segment, stores it under URLFormatCtxKey, and trims it from rctx.RoutePath before calling next.

itens.descricao: Stores a key and value pair on the request context chain for downstream handlers, returning a new request with the value attached.
itens.motivo: WithValue builds a middleware that attaches the key/value to a new request context via r.WithContext(context.WithValue(...)) before calling next.

itens.descricao: Wraps an http.ResponseWriter to record status and bytes written, optionally teeing the body, and exposes Unwrap, plus Flush or Hijack when the underlying writer supports them.
itens.motivo: basicWriter records status code and bytes, supports Tee and Unwrap, and the constructor picks Flush/Hijack variants only when the underlying writer implements those interfaces.

itens.descricao: Parses request paths, records URL params, and executes a chained middleware stack before the radix tree endpoint, implementing http.Handler for the standard library.
itens.motivo: Mux.ServeHTTP is the http.Handler; it sets up a pooled routing context, runs the middleware chain built by updateRouteHandler, and routeHTTP then looks up the radix tree and sets URL params.

itens.descricao: Stores routes in a radix trie with static, regexp, param, and catch-all node types, and supports registering custom HTTP methods through RegisterMethod.
itens.motivo: nodeTyp defines static, regexp, param and catch-all node kinds in a radix tree, and RegisterMethod adds custom methods to methodMap.
